$comment: accordion.json's content role has no declared children, so the panel is laid out as collection-showcase.json's replace node describes: figure.salt-showcase__panel.salt-showcase__quote with the rating, a blockquote and a figcaption holding the meta line. The group name showcase-<context.index> is written on the accordion root (the checker requires it there, from the replace node's attributes) and on each details. The rating label reads "Rated 5 of 5": labels.rating followed by "{n} of {N}".
summary: Testimonials as an accordion on the inverse band: each person's name is the summary, and the panel holds the rating, the quote and a caption line with their role. All closed by default.

testimonials.title: Maya Okafor
testimonials.text: They turned a patch of builders' rubble into a garden we use every evening.

testimonials.title: Tom Ashby
testimonials.text: The terrace planting has had more compliments than the menu.

testimonials.title: Priya Nair
testimonials.text: Reliable, tidy and good with volunteers of every age.
